event.name: Thousand Springs Festival of the Arts

notes.subject: 2026 reply — not a fit for Thousand Springs Festival format
notes.body: On Aug. 27, 2026, Jude Metzler, Project Coordinator for the Magic Valley Arts Council, declined Adventure Zone for Thousand Springs Festival of the Arts. Reasons: Thousand Springs State Park is small and grounds are prioritized for vendor booths and food trucks; MVAC intentionally wants the festival focused 100% on the arts and does not want a carnival-like theme; they feel inflatable attractions would distract from the festival's core idea. Current contact confirmed: Jude Metzler, Project Coordinator, magicvalleyartscouncil@magicvalleyartscouncil.org, 208-734-2787. Current MVAC programs reviewed include Art & Soul, Arts on Tour, Kids Art in the Park, Jazz on the Canyon, Missoula Children's Theater, gallery/classes, and Thousand Springs. These programs are also strongly arts-focused, so do not routinely pitch another current MVAC arts program. No routine follow-up should be created. Keep the organization eligible only if MVAC later becomes involved in a broader community/family event where a separate staffed attraction area could genuinely fit. Desiree drafted a respectful acknowledgment reply on Aug. 27, 2026.
